hero.description: OneBox removes the friction between channels. It unifies WhatsApp, Slack, Email and more into a smart inbox your whole team can use.
hero.descriptionStrong: And it runs real actions inside your projects.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From fragmented channels to unified clarity in three simple steps
how.step1Desc: Define your project, add participants and connect the channels you use.
how.step2Desc: Our AI understands requests, blockers and decisions across your conversations.
how.step3Desc: Tasks get created, the team is notified, blockers are flagged — automatically.

diff.description: Decisions live in conversations. But execution doesn’t happen there. OneBox is the layer that connects what you say with what gets done.
diff.item1Desc: They organize, they display. That’s it.
diff.item2Desc: If X then Y. Rigid, brittle, limited.
diff.item3Desc: We understand context, detect intent and act inside your projects.
diff.previewFooter: "See everything OneBox has already done for you"
